## 📚 Textbooks
1. **Schoerghofer, N. (2019)**. *Lessons in Scientific Computing*. CRC Press.
2. **Izaac, J., & Wang, J. (2018)**. *Computational Quantum Mechanics*. Springer.
3. **Turner, P., Arildsen, T., & Kavanagh, K. (2018)**. *Applied Scientific Computing with Python*. Springer.
4. **Linge, S., & Langtangen, H. P. (2019)**. *Programming for Computations - Python* (2nd ed.). Springer.
5. **Fatica, M., & Ruetsch, G. (2013)**. *CUDA Fortran for Scientists and Engineers*. Morgan Kaufmann.
